question: Should the next 2026.7.1 beta include this broad Ultra backport after exact-head release validation?
rationale: The capability and implementation direction were accepted on main, but release timing and cross-surface backport risk require a release-owner decision.

options.title: Validate and include
options.body: Require exact-head live and broad release checks, then include the backport if behavior matches the canonical implementation.

options.title: Defer to later release
options.body: Avoid the beta-line compatibility risk and ship Ultra from a later release line.

recommendation.title: Validate and include
recommendation.body: Require exact-head live and broad release checks, then include the backport if behavior matches the canonical implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They co-authored the canonical integration and have the strongest history-based connection to the release-wide provider and session behavior.
